content: NumPy reproducibility for Generator requires same build, environment, machine and same API call sequence; results may diverge across builds, BLAS/LAPACK and CPU floating-point. Record lockfile, versions, seed, deterministic execution assumptions, and test tolerances across Windows/Ubuntu instead of demanding bitwise parity. Source: https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/random/compatibility.html ; https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/random/generator.html
